shots.name: chroma-key-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Chroma Key card: Preset menu showing Fine Hair, then the Key section (Screen: Green, View: Final result), Matte (Clip Black 0.15, Clip White 0.95), Edge (Shrink / Grow and Softness at 0 px) and Spill (Suppression 1.00, Method: Neutral), beside a strip of the preview with the keyed dancer
shots.caption: Chroma Key with the Fine Hair preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Screen: the colour to key. 3 — View: the result or the matte. 4 — Clip Black: background away. 5 — Shrink / Grow: the edge in or out.

shots.name: slit-scan-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Slit Scan card: Preset menu showing Wave Folds, then the Time section (Preview: Result, Delay 2 s, Time factor 1, Profile: Wave / folds, Scan direction: Left → right, Angle 0, Mix 1, Time bands 0) and the closed Wave and Sampling sections, beside the preview
shots.caption: Slit Scan with the Wave Folds preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Preview: the result or the time map. 3 — Delay (s): how far back. 4 — Profile: the shape of time. 5 — Time bands: steps instead of a smear.

shots.name: time-stack-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Time Stack card: Preset menu showing Chorus, then Instances 5, Time offset 0.50 s, Decay 0.90, Blend mode Lighten, Preview size Full and Frame cache 1 GiB, with the summary line under them, beside a strip of the preview with the dancer and a faint copy
shots.caption: Time Stack with the Chorus preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Instances: how many copies. 3 — Time offset: the time between them. 4 — Decay: how much fainter each older copy gets. 5 — Blend mode: how the copies combine.

shots.name: kinetic-trace-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Motion Trails card: Preset menu showing Neon Trace, History Loop Reset, then Length 0.93, Tint 0.50, a cyan Overlay swatch and Amount 1.00, beside a strip of the preview at the edge of a dark stage
shots.caption: Motion Trails with the Neon Trace preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Length: how long the trail lasts. 3 — Tint: how strongly the trail takes on the Overlay colour. 4 — Overlay: the trail's colour. 5 — Amount: how strongly the effect shows.
